properties.title: U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) says U.S. forces disabled the Palau flagged bulk carrier Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman on Nov. 26 after
properties.description:
U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) says U.S. forces disabled the Palau flagged bulk carrier Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman on Nov. 26 after its crew tried to run the blockade of Iran despite multiple warnings. 

A U.S. military aircraft struck the ship's stern with precision munitions, disabling its propulsion. CENTCOM says the civilian crew was unharmed. 

The ship departed from Bandar Abbas, Iran. According to CENTCOM, it is the sixth vessel disabled since enforcement resumed in July. U.S. forces have also redirected 158 ships that complied.
